title: Getting started
summary: Get the launcher ready to join a TAOM server.

sections.heading: What you need (1.4.8 only)
steps: Subscribe to Bannerlord Coop on the Steam Workshop (3770450698).
TAOM.CoopCompat 0.3.25 needs Coop 0.1.6, and Steam now has Coop 0.1.7.
Get BannerlordCoop-v0.1.6.zip from Coop's GitHub v0.1.6 release and unzip it into the game's Modules folder, so SubModule.xml sits in Modules\Coop.
That Coop loads before the Workshop one. While TAOM needs it, Get Coop 0.1.6 on the Play page opens that release.
Download TAOM 2.0.29.5 from ModDB and keep it zipped. The TAOM.CoopCompat 0.3.25 CLIENT zip is built into the launcher.
sections.tip: The TAOM zip is big, about 18 GB. The launcher finds it anywhere on your PC, so Downloads is fine.

sections.heading: Set up the game (1.4.8 only)
steps: Click Check mods. It looks for every module of your setup and does not download anything.
On the Settings page, click Install or repair TAOM. It installs TAOM and TAOM.CoopCompat, or repairs them when they match.
Use Workshop Coop 0.1.6 on the Settings page moves other Coop copies out of Modules. With a newer Workshop Coop it stops, unless your own 0.1.6 is in Modules.

sections.heading: Set up the game (1.5.7)
steps: Download BannerlordCoop-v0.1.8.zip from Coop's GitHub release and unzip it into Bannerlord's Modules folder.
Install TAOM 2.0.41 or newer, then click Install or repair TAOM. It installs matching bundled TAOM.CoopCompat for 2.0.41 or 2.0.42.
Close Bannerlord, click Check mods, then click Connect using the address and port from your host.

sections.heading: Good to know
steps: Pick your language with the 🌐 button at the bottom of the sidebar.
Older TAOM 2.0.27 campaigns do not load on 2.0.29.5, so the host has to start a new campaign.
When an update is out, a bar at the top shows Install update.
Press What's new next to the language button to see what changed in the last few versions.
